Truckstop’s Partner Community

Welcome Letter
Welcome to the Truckstop Partner Community!
We are thrilled to have you join us in this collaborative journey towards mutual success. 
At Truckstop, we believe in the power of partnerships and the strength of community, 
and we are excited to embark on this journey together.
Our partner community is more than just a network of businesses; it’s a vibrant 
ecosystem where ideas flourish, collaborations thrive, and innovation fuels the 
transportation industry. By joining forces, we can achieve far more than we could alone. 
Together, we are better equipped to tackle challenges, explore new opportunities, and 
drive meaningful impact for mutual customers.
We deeply value the trust you have placed in us and are committed to supporting your 
growth and success. Our team is here to provide you with the resources, support, and 
expertise you need to maximize our partnership’s potential. Together, we can create 
exceptional value for our carriers, brokers, shippers and make a lasting impact in our 
respective industries.
Thank you for choosing to partner with us. We ‘re honored to have the opportunity to 
work alongside you and are looking forward to a prosperous and fulfilling partnership.
Warm regards, 
Alan Alberto
Director of Partnerships & Alliances
PS – Let’s connect on LinkedIn if we aren’t already connected.

Truckstop’s Partner Community

Truckstop was founded in 1995 in small-town Idaho as the Internet’s first load board—a better way for truck drivers to 
find loads, connect to brokers, and run a more efficient business. Nearly 30 years later, we’re still delivering on what 
we started: innovative solutions that help carriers, brokers, and shippers handle every phase of the freight lifecycle 
with ease, speed, and confidence. With corporate headquarters in Boise, Idaho, today Truckstop employs nearly 700 
people across the nation, all dedicated to supporting America’s freight professionals with the technology tools they 
need to succeed in an ever-changing industry.

Partner Spotlight Series
Each month we select a strategic partner to feature in front of our internal teams. This 
partner has shown a commitment to our partnership, is a leader in our referral program, 
and drives a clear joint value proposition.
Benefits
Lunch & learn, spotlight in the monthly sales town hall, and featured on the revenue team 
SharePoint site.
How to Qualify
The selection is up to Truckstop’s discretion. Internally, we review which partner has 
contributed the highest volume of leads, closed won business, and mutual customers. We 
want to ensure that we’re rewarding and featuring partners who are mutually invested in 
the success of Truckstop.

Truckstop Factoring 
Hand off your invoicing paperwork for hassle-free billing and faster pay. Truckstop Factoring offers flexible 
terms, a flat fee, and guaranteed payment even if the broker fails to pay. For ultimate convenience, you can 
even factor loads on the go with Truckstop Go
ITS Dispatch TMS 
Being an independent owner-operator means much more than just driving a truck. It means running a 
business. Truckstop’s transportation management system helps you get a handle on paperwork, tax reporting, 
load processing, and more. You can save up to 18 hours a week, process up to 31% more loads, and increase 
profits up to 12%.
Get Your Authority 
If you’re thinking of becoming your own boss and running your own 
trucking operation, don’t go it alone. Instead of jumping through 
hoops and fighting red tape, look to Truckstop to handle the heavy 
lifting. Our authority packages take the hassle out of the process, so 
you can focus on starting and growing your business.
Seamless Onboarding with Top Brokers 
Enjoy quick, easy, and paperless onboarding with brokers who use 
RMIS to help fight fraud. Once you’re onboarded with RMIS, you’re 
good to go with the best in the business.
